propositions: The rebar-janitor Discovery phase does not consult rebar metrics for historical code-health trend evidence, relying only on one-shot snapshot tools (cloc, tokei, ast-grep).

Agents and contributors cannot discover the rebar metrics surface or its registered lenses (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) because they are not referenced in project documentation.
The rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec and REGISTRY) is not documented as a reusable library surface for tool integration.
The unavailable state (metrics whose signal has not yet accrued) must be explicitly documented so agents do not misinterpret absence as zero.
Documentation changes to discovery.md, user-guide.md, reuse-surface.md, and AGENTS.md will make metrics usable and discoverable without requiring source code changes or new runtime behavior.
